title: Deep learning-driven  de novo  design of ribosome binding sites in  Paracoccus denitrificans

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep learning-driven  de novo  design of ribosome binding sites in  Paracoccus denitrificans》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Paracoccus denitrificans is a heterotrophic nitrifying-aerobic denitrifying bacterium widely used in wastewater treatment and as a model system for studying electron transport chains, making it a promising chassis for environmental synthetic biology.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Deep learning-driven  de novo  design of ribosome binding sites in  Paracoccus denitrificans》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We found that RBS strength is predominantly governed by a purine-rich Shine-Dalgarno motif located 5-8 bp upstream of the start codon, with specific A/G patterns in this region serving as key determinants.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Building on this dataset, we developed and compared CNN, BiLSTM, and Transformer models for RBS strength prediction; among them, the CNN achieved the highest predictive correlation (Pearson r = 0.68).

evidence.text: We found that RBS strength is predominantly governed by a purine-rich Shine-Dalgarno motif located 5-8 bp upstream of the start codon, with specific A/G patterns in this region serving as key determinants.

Building on this dataset, we developed and compared CNN, BiLSTM, and Transformer models for RBS strength prediction; among them, the CNN achieved the highest predictive correlation (Pearson r = 0.68).
